item.title: Estonia Approves Draft of First National Space Activities Act
item.summary: The Estonian government has approved a draft Space Activities Act that would establish the country's first comprehensive legal framework for regulating space activities. Approved on November 26, 2026, the proposed legislation aims to support the growth of Estonia's commercial space sector, attract investment, and provide companies and investors with greater legal certainty when planning and conducting space missions.
